title: 第572章 木谷梨乃帮忙第571章 大竹梨莎
content_zh:
木谷梨乃在外面等了一会，没听见里面的动静，就开门进来查看。
她看见两人还坐在床上，衣服都好端端地穿在身上。
木谷梨乃急了，质问道，“你们怎么回事，怎么半天没动静？”
大竹梨莎红着脸说，“我太紧张了，我不行啊。”
木谷梨乃没好气地说，“你紧张个毛线啊，没见过男人吗？”
“是啊，我都一年没见男人了啊。”
“你就当他是你失散多年的恋人。”
“可是他不是呀。”
“你就不能假想一下吗？抓紧时间，太晚了，外面的保镖要怀疑的。”
“你再给我点时间，让我适应一下。”
“我去，哪有这么麻烦的，还是我来吧。”
木谷梨乃把大竹梨莎推倒在床上，动手脱她的外套。
大竹梨莎双手抓住衣服，“梨乃，你要干什么？”
“你不是紧张吗，我帮你，你马上就不紧张了。”
木谷梨乃精通擒拿术，两下子就制服了大竹梨莎。
大竹梨莎的脸上飞起一丝红霞，“梨乃，这太难为情了！”
“你闭上眼，就不会难为情了。”
大竹梨莎见挣扎也没有用，只好闭上眼睛，任凭木谷梨乃一通操作。
木谷梨乃拍了叶开一巴掌，训斥道，“这点事都办不好，还要姐姐我亲自动手，抓紧时间，给我上！”
说完，她就出去了，把门也关上了。

大竹梨莎躺在床上，双手抱在胸前，身体微微颤抖，就像一只待宰的羔羊一样，我见犹怜。
真是一个可人儿，可怜人儿，被大竹晋三打压多年，太难了。
叶开安慰道，“梨莎，你真不容易，你受苦了。”
大竹梨莎一听非常感动，眼泪都出来了，“是啊，我三月不知肉味，和出家差不多了。”
两人聊了一会，大竹梨莎不紧张了，自觉地投入叶开的怀抱......
一小时后，两人稍事休息，穿上外套，从暗室出来。
木谷梨乃问道，“怎么样？”
大竹梨莎不好意思地点点头。
“大功告成，咱们该撤了。”
三人从包间出来，看见几个保镖还在外面等着。
木谷梨乃假模假式地和大竹梨莎告别，
“今天就这样了，咱们抽时间再聚。”
大竹梨莎彬彬有礼地说，“好的，撒呦娜拉。”
大竹梨莎袅袅娜娜地走了，几个保镖跟在后边。
content_en:
Rino Kidani waited outside for a while, but when she didn't hear any movement inside, she opened the door and came in to check.
She saw the two of them still sitting on the bed, with their clothes on.
Rino Kidani became anxious and asked, "What's wrong with you? Why haven't you made any movement for a long time?"
Ozhu Risa blushed and said, "I'm too nervous, I can't do it."
Rino Kidani said angrily, "You are so nervous. Have you never seen a man?"
"Yeah, I haven't seen a man in a year."
"Just think of him as your long-lost lover."
"But he's not."
"Can't you just make some assumptions? Hurry up, it's too late, the bodyguards outside will be suspicious."
"Give me some more time to get used to it."
"I'll go, there's no such trouble, I'll do it."
Rino Kidani pushed Otake Risa onto the bed and started to take off her coat.
Otake Risa grabbed her clothes with both hands, "Rino, what do you want to do?"
"Aren't you nervous? If I help you, you won't be nervous right away."
Kitani Rino is proficient in grappling skills and subdued Otake Risa in two strokes.
A trace of blush flew up on Otake Risa's face, "Rino, this is so embarrassing!"
"If you close your eyes, you won't be embarrassed."
Seeing that struggling was useless, Otake Risa had no choice but to close her eyes and let Kitani Rino operate.
Kitani Rino slapped Ye Kai and scolded, "You can't handle this even if you want me to do it myself, sister, hurry up and do it for me!"
After saying that, she went out and closed the door.
Dazhulisha was lying on the bed, holding her hands on her chest, her body trembling slightly, like a lamb waiting to be slaughtered, I felt pity for her.
What a lovely, pitiful person. It is so difficult to be suppressed by Otake Shinzo for many years.
Ye Kai comforted, "Lisha, it's not easy for you. You have suffered."
Dazhulisha was very moved when she heard this and burst into tears, "Yes, I don't know the taste of meat for three months, which is almost as good as becoming a monk."
The two chatted for a while, and Dazhulisha was no longer nervous, and consciously threw herself into Ye Kai's arms...
An hour later, the two took a short break, put on their coats, and came out of the darkroom.
Kitani Rino asked, "How is it?"
Ozhu Risa nodded sheepishly.
"We're done, it's time for us to withdraw."
The three of them came out of the private room and saw several bodyguards waiting outside.
Kitani Rino said goodbye to Otake Risa in a fake way,
"That's it for today. Let's get together again some time."
Dazhulisha said politely, "Okay, Sayonara."
Ozhulisha walked away gracefully, followed by several bodyguards.
